# Sibe — Cloud CAD Management for SolidWorks

## Overview

Sibe is a cloud CAD management workspace for SolidWorks teams. The product is positioned around a familiar SolidWorks workflow with cloud version control, CAD file management, revision approval, BOM/product data workflows, browser-based 2D and 3D reviews, and collaboration with project managers, customers, suppliers, and other non-CAD stakeholders.

The primary production site is https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/. The product website is https://www.sibe.io/ and the product trial is available at https://app.sibe.io/.

## Cloud CAD management for SolidWorks teams

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/cloud-cad-management/

Cloud CAD management for SolidWorks is a shared online workspace for files, references, versions, revisions, product data, and browser-based collaboration. Sibe connects that workspace to the SolidWorks workflow so teams can control designs without relying only on folders, email, or customer-managed servers.

Key topics include SolidWorks version control, remote access without a VPN, browser-based collaboration, product data around the assembly, cloud PDM evaluation, revision approvals, BOM management, and a phased workflow evaluation using a representative assembly.

## CAD file management

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/cad-file-management/

The CAD file management page addresses SolidWorks parts, assemblies, drawings, references, metadata, versions, check-in/check-out, and controlled review. The intended workflow keeps the native SolidWorks add-in connected to a cloud workspace and makes file relationships easier to follow across engineering and downstream teams.

## SolidWorks revision approval workflow

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/solidworks-revision-approval-workflow/

The revision approval page describes a workflow that moves designs from In Progress to Pending Approval to Released. It emphasizes version history, release notes, browser reviews, reviewer comments, markups, and a record of the release decision tied to the exact design version.

## SolidWorks BOM management

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/solidworks-bom-management/

The BOM management page focuses on using SolidWorks assembly structure and part metadata as the starting point for an indented BOM and downstream product data. Topics include nested subassemblies, custom properties, version-aware product data, manufacturing exports, purchasing, and production planning.

## Remote engineering collaboration for SolidWorks teams

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/features/remote-team-collaboration-for-solidworks-teams/

The remote collaboration page explains how distributed engineering teams can work around the same controlled design version. Engineers continue in SolidWorks while project managers, customers, suppliers, quality teams, and reviewers use browser-based views, controlled access, comments, markups, and review history.

## SolidWorks PDM migration to the cloud

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/cloud-pdm/solidworks-pdm-migration/

The migration page recommends a phased evaluation rather than a large infrastructure change at the start. A representative assembly can be used to validate references, subassemblies, version control, approvals, remote reviews, permissions, and the day-to-day usability of a cloud CAD management workflow.

## Product facts represented on the public pages

Sibe is represented as a web-based business application. The public pages describe a 14-day free trial, cloud CAD management, SolidWorks version control, CAD file management, revision approval workflows, BOM management, browser-based collaboration, and external design reviews. Readers should confirm current plan limits, supported file formats, export behavior, and product availability through the official product website, pricing page, or demo.

## Discoverability resources

The XML sitemap is available at https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/sitemap.xml. Robots instructions are at https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/robots.txt. The site publishes JSON-LD structured data on its HTML pages, including WebPage, Organization, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, and FAQPage entities where applicable.

## Natural-language information endpoint

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/ask/

The Ask Sibe endpoint provides read-only informational answers about public Sibe CAD content, including cloud CAD management, SolidWorks version control, BOM workflows, browser collaboration, trial details, pricing links, security links, and contact options. It exposes a declarative WebMCP form named `askSibe` and a guarded imperative `document.modelContext.registerTool` implementation when supported by the browser. It does not create accounts, submit purchases, change subscriptions, access private workspace data, or perform destructive actions.

## Editorial methodology

URL: https://sibe-cad.vercel.app/editorial-methodology/

The Editorial Methodology page explains that product and SEO content is checked against official Sibe product, About, security, demo, pricing, and feature pages. It describes original explanations, visible publication and review dates, source linking, accessibility checks, structured data checks, and post-deployment route verification.
